items.title: Classic Flash Villain Gets A Cronenberg Twist With New Family Lore
items.summary: Jeff Lemire and Haining's Absolute Flash has certainly been a journey in DC's massive Absolute Universe lineup thanks to numerous fascinating tweaks to classic comics lore. Focusing on Wally West and his journey to free his father from the Still Point, the story has incorporated iconic villains from his rogues' gallery as surprisingly cooperative antiheroes or outright allies. One particular classic enemy, Gorilla Grodd, is presented in this case as simply Grodd, has been an indispensable ally to Wally so far, as a frankly adorable genetically-enhanced monkey companion. But the death of his father has clearly lingered , and is resurfacing in the latest issue.
items.t: Classic Flash Villain Gets A Cronenberg Twist With New Family Lore

items.title: 5 Near-Perfect Fantasy Books, Recommended by Brandon Sanderson
items.summary: Brandon Sanderson is one of the most popular authors in the fantasy genre right now , yet he never misses a chance to pay his success forward. Sanderson has made headlines for steering the publishing industry itself and advocating for other writers along the way. His story of single-minded focus on becoming a professional author is inspiring to many readers, and he often encourages aspiring young writers to read as much as possible. However, Sanderson qualifies all of his book recommendations with the caveat that not every book will resonate with every reader. He encourages fans to read widely and seek out what interests them most.
items.t: 5 Near-Perfect Fantasy Books, Recommended by Brandon Sanderson
